rows.label: tlk70000121_04_msg0001
rows.name:
I stowed away on a regular ship to
make some money in Iira, but now
things have gotten serious...

rows.label: tlk70000121_04_msg0002
rows.name: ...Uck! Did I say that out loud?

rows.label: tlk70000121_04_msg0003
rows.name:
Well, whatever. I was thinking of
giving up that life anyway...

rows.label: tlk70000121_04_msg0004
rows.name:
I've been living alone for a
long time now...and I've done
some pretty bad things.

rows.label: tlk70000121_04_msg0005
rows.name:
It's tough for a little girl to
grow up by herself here in Gula.

rows.label: tlk70000121_04_msg0006
rows.name:
But if you think you can turn
things around, I think I can dare
to dream too, just a little!
